Sec. 2. Athlete of the Year Award

1.1. Description. This award is given to a student who excels in the field of Sports. His/her representation in the field of Sports made him known to other institutions through his/her exemplary performance that led to the university’s recognition, thus strengthening its external relations with other states, universities and colleges.

1.2. Recommendation

1.2.1. The Chairperson of Sports Development of this University shall recommend top three (3) performing athletes of the year. The following conditions shall be considered by the Chairperson of Sports Development prior to deliberation:

1.2.1.1. The awardee has no derogatory records reported to the Office of Students Affairs and Guidance and Counseling Office.

1.2.1.2. The awardee represented the university in the field of sports and won in various competitions recognizing the name of the university.

1.2.2.

1.2.1.2. The awardee represented the university in the field of sports and won in various competitions recognizing the name of the university.

1.2.2. With the letter of recommendation, the athletes shall attach certifications to prove authenticity of the performance and these certifications shall likewise be used as basis in crediting relative points per achievement and involvement performed.

1.2.3. In the absence of certificates, the nominee shall list down all the competitions he/she participated in, duly signed and authenticated by the Chairperson of Sports Development.

1.2.4. A one (1) page narrative report for each recommended candidates shall be submitted by the candidates duly signed by the Chairperson of Sports Development.

1.3. Criteria for Evaluation. The nominee of this award shall be evaluated according to the following:

1.3.1. Technical-based Evaluation, seventy percent (70%). Crediting of points shall be based on the following:

1.3.1.1. Participation Credits

1.3. Selection and Screening Committee. The Committee on Awards and Recognition (comprised of Committee Chair, Co-chair and three [3] members) and the SSC Adviser will be the committee in selecting for this award if in case the award will not be given to the President of SSC.

1.4. Screening and Selection Process. The Screening and Selection Committee shall ask the top three (3) officers for a narrative report duly authenticated and signed by the adviser of the said organization and conduct a panel interview to screen and select the recipient of this award with the observance of its objective and productive evaluation as indicated earlier. A decision shall be finalized by the Committee on Awards and Recognition and SSC Adviser to whom this award is to be given.

trace.answer_for_eval:
The criteria for the Athlete of the Year Award are as follows:

1. The student must excel in the field of Sports and be recognized for exemplary performance that enhances the university’s reputation and external relations.
2. The student must have represented the university in sports competitions and won in various events.
3. The student must have no derogatory records reported to the Office of Students Affairs and Guidance and Counseling Office.
4. The student must provide certifications or authenticated documentation of their achievements, or list all participated competitions signed by the Chairperson of Sports Development.
5. The evaluation criteria include:
   - Technical-based Evaluation (70%), which considers participation credits and ranking/percentage points based on competition level and placement.
   - Initiative and Responsibility Performance (20%), which assesses positive effects on student welfare and development.
6. The selection process involves a recommendation from the Chairperson of Sports Development, review of certifications or a signed list of competitions, submission of a narrative report, and a panel interview conducted by the Committee on Awards and Recognition and the SSC Adviser.
